evals.name: Validated B2B Operational Problem Discovery & 35-Point Scoring
evals.prompt: Execute evidence-driven problem discovery on Subcontractor Certificate of Insurance (COI) expiration tracking with manual Excel logs, missed renewals resulting in legal liability, and $150/mo Zapier spend across 8 general contractors.
evals.expected_output: Extracts Level 1 behavioral evidence, maps 14-node workflow, scores candidate >= 28 PTS (Tier-1 Gold Problem), evaluates commercial guard, and derives 3-tier solution wedge.
assertions: Deconstructs workflow using 14-node forensic mapping
Identifies active Willingness to Pay (WTP) economic signals
Computes 35-point evidence score exceeding 28 points
Derives 3-tier production solution wedge

evals.name: Validated Developer Tooling & API Contract Pipeline
evals.prompt: Investigate recurring breaking changes in multi-service backend deployments where REST API endpoint response schemas drift between NestJS microservices without automated CI contract testing.
evals.expected_output: Maps 14-node developer workflow, verifies Level 1 error logs, scores candidate >= 28 PTS, and scopes 3-tier prototype (Tier 1 CLI schema linter, Tier 2 GitHub Action, Tier 3 schema registry SaaS).
assertions: Identifies developer glue-work and configuration drift across services
Enforces Evidence Quality Ladder hard gate
Scores candidate above 28 points as a Tier-1 Gold Problem
Derives 3-tier solution wedge tailored for developer tooling

evals.name: Saturation Trap Gatekeeper Disqualification
evals.prompt: Evaluate a product idea proposing a smart apartment society visitor gate management and maintenance fee collection mobile app for residential housing societies.
evals.expected_output: Screens candidate against Saturation Trap Gatekeeper, identifies entrenched funded giants (MyGate, NoBrokerHood) and multi-month committee voting, and parks candidate immediately.
assertions: Identifies brutally saturated market category dominated by funded competitors
Detects lengthy committee / AGM multi-month decision friction
Triggers Saturation Trap Gatekeeper stop check
Parks candidate without proceeding to prototype design

evals.name: Commercial Already-Solved Stop Check Trigger
evals.prompt: Evaluate a problem discovery candidate proposing a basic PDF freelance invoice generator with simple receipt export.
evals.expected_output: Executes commercial pre-scoring scan, identifies >= 3 modern SaaS under $50/mo (Wave, Invoice Ninja), triggers Stop Check #3, and parks/archives candidate.
assertions: Executes commercial alternative search query
Detects existing affordable SaaS solutions under $50 per month
Triggers Stop Check #3 for commercial alternative fits well
Parks or archives candidate without writing code

evals.name: No-Problem Fallback Anti-Hallucination Rejection
evals.prompt: Evaluate user feedback stating that a SaaS application button color is annoying without any operational consequence, financial loss, or maintained workaround.
evals.expected_output: Classifies friction as low-consequence complaint, scores candidate < 15 PTS, and outputs mandatory No-Problem fallback anti-hallucination message.
assertions: Classifies friction as cosmetic complaint or inconvenience
Calculates 35-point score below 15 points
Outputs mandatory no-problem fallback message
Rejects premature solution prototyping
